title: Valuation Routes Behind the Appraised Sum of a Loss
content:
The appraised sum of a loss standing behind a deductible recovery on a Keyturn Host Payout Account is measured on the route the loss was valued by. The route is the one carried by the most recent appraisal made under the host's Keyturn Host Protection Plan enrolment, and it decides which records enter the appraised sum.

| Route the most recent appraisal was taken from | The appraised sum |
|---|---|
| A repair shop invoice | That appraisal together with every supplement added under the enrolment |
| A total loss valuation | The vehicle value declared at enrolment, supplements never being added to a total loss |
| Any other route | The appraisal alone |

Each of the three sums is rounded half to even to two decimal places.

## Input, judgement, result

**Input.** The most recent appraisal made under the enrolment was taken from a repair shop invoice; the appraisal stands at a hypothetical 3000.00 USD and two supplements of a hypothetical 500.00 USD and 250.00 USD have been added under the enrolment. **Judgement.** The first route governs. **Result.** The appraised sum is 3750.00 USD.

**Input.** The most recent appraisal made under the enrolment was taken from a total loss valuation; the appraisal stands at a hypothetical 3000.00 USD, the vehicle value declared at enrolment is a hypothetical 22000.00 USD, and supplements of a hypothetical 500.00 USD stand under the enrolment. **Judgement.** The second route governs. **Result.** The appraised sum is 22000.00 USD, the supplements being left out.

**Input.** The most recent appraisal under the enrolment came by neither of those routes and stands at a hypothetical 3000.00 USD. **Judgement.** The third row governs. **Result.** The appraised sum is 3000.00 USD.

The records that decide the route are the claim records held under the host's Keyturn Host Protection Plan enrolment, which carry for each appraisal the sum appraised, the channel the appraisal came through and the day it was made, together with the supplements booked against the enrolment and the vehicle value declared on it.
